name: dotnet-ddd
description: Domain-Driven Design best practices for .NET 10 domain code. Use when creating or reviewing entities, value objects, aggregates, aggregate roots, repositories, domain services, bounded contexts, or domain events in C#. Use when refactoring anemic models toward rich domain logic, enforcing aggregate invariants, or checking bounded-context boundaries. Provides tactical-pattern guidance, strategic-design rules, and a file:line review checklist. Complements dotnet-clean-architecture (hexagonal layering) and dotnet-cop (pre-merge review enforcement).
